title: Internet connection troubleshooting
content: If a customer's internet connection is unavailable, ask them to restart the router and check the physical network connections. If the problem continues, check whether there is a known service outage.

title: Billing charge investigation
content: For an unrecognized charge, verify the invoice and transaction details. Do not promise a refund before the charge has been investigated.

title: Password reset
content: Customers who cannot reset their password should verify that they are using the correct email address and check their spam or junk folder for the reset message.

title: Delayed shipment
content: For delayed shipments, check the latest tracking information and estimated delivery date. If the shipment has not moved for an extended period, the case may require investigation.

title: Suspicious account activity
content: Suspicious account activity should be treated as a security concern. Verify the customer's identity using approved procedures and escalate cases involving possible account compromise.
